In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of a 2-mercaptoethanol (2-ME) treatment in the IGRA test is an important step to reduce the false positive results and to improve the specificity of the test.
the diagnosis of latent TB infection (LTBI) should be based on an IGRA, and the diagnosis of TB disease should be based on the presence of a positive AFB smear and a positive culture.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed and validated a number of novel tools for the diagnosis of TB, and have shown that they are more sensitive and specific than current tests, and that they can be used in the field.
the NTM-TBDI is a very useful tool for the diagnosis of NTM lung disease.
the NTM-Tb INSIGHTS newsletter is a great way to keep the public up to date about new information about NTM lung disease and TB.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the immune response of patients with NTM lung disease is very different from that of patients with active TB, and that these two diseases should be considered separately in future studies.
the current tests for diagnosing latent TB infection (LTBI) have limitations and that we need to improve the accuracy of LTBI tests.
the use of the QuantiFERON-TB Gold In-Tube test is a promising tool for the diagnosis of active tuberculosis (TB).
